description: Estimate the annual and monthly cost of employing people in a country through an EOR: gross salary, plus the country's representative employer contribution rate, plus the EOR fee (a provider's published fee, or one you supply from a quote), plus other monthly costs. A budget illustration, not a payroll quote: contribution caps and thresholds are not applied.

annual_salary_usd.description: Annual gross salary per employee, in USD.

country.description: Country name, two-letter ISO code or slug.

employees.description: Number of employees on this salary (default 1).

monthly_fee_usd.description: EOR fee per employee per month from a quote, in USD. Overrides the provider's published fee.

other_monthly_costs_usd.description: Other costs per employee per month (benefits, allowances), in USD. Default 0.

provider.description: EOR provider whose published fee to use, e.g. 'Deel'.

name: estimate_eor_cost
title: Estimate EOR employment cost
